name: KUT Monthly Report
description: Kampala Uganda Temple — the monthly BIM status report / KPI set from proposal Section 4.6. Chains the read-only metrics that feed the report: model-health score (open clash count + warnings + duplicate elements + unplaced rooms + file-size trend), naming/metadata completeness %, per-discipline compliance, sheet ISO 19650 compliance, the exchange/sheet register, the KPI trend versus prior months, and the composite dashboard. No step writes model DATA, but this is not a read-only workflow: CompletenessDashboard and DiscComplianceReport are [Transaction(TransactionMode.Manual)] and build or refresh a 'STING Compliance Legend' view inside a transaction. They stay in the chain because they produce the naming/metadata compliance KPI the report is for. Safe to run on any published state as far as model data goes; expect a legend view to appear or update. If you need a look that changes nothing at all, run WORKFLOW_KUT_GateAudit first. Export artefacts land under the project output folder for attachment to the monthly report.
